scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w @vybe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vybe/web && cd apps/api && ./mvnw -q -DskipTests package
scripts.start: npm run build && cd apps/api && VYBE_WEB_DIR=../web/dist java -jar target/vybe-api.jar
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vybe/web && cd apps/api && ./mvnw -q test
scripts.seed: echo 'Seeding runs automatically on API startup (VYBE_AUTOSEED=true)'
